guide: Open Start and type your agency name and your own rules in the yellow cells: a strong and a weak engagement rate, the benchmark tolerance, how close a goal must be and the smallest lift that counts in a test.
Fill Brand Clients with one row for each brand. The followers, reach, engagement rate, goals met and result level fill in from the monthly results.

Every month, enter one row for each client and platform on Monthly Results: followers, followers gained, reach, impressions, engagements, clicks, video views, saves, shares and posts. The rates and the benchmark check fill in.
Keep Benchmarks up to date for each industry and platform. Every monthly result is marked above, on par or below the benchmark using your tolerance.
Enter the posts you want to study on Post Performance. The interactions, engagement rate and level fill in, and Format Performance and Time Of Day use them to show what works best.
Pick the best and worst posts of each month on Top And Bottom Posts, write the lesson and the next action, and let the rate come from the post list.
Set monthly goals on Goals Vs Actual and read the status. Follower Growth shows where new followers come from and how many you lose again.
Record the audience on Audience Demographics, the website visits on Website Traffic and the leads, sales and spend on Conversions And Leads for the cost per lead and the return.
Track competitors on Competitor Tracking and test ideas on Experiments. The share of audience, the position and the winner are worked out for you.
Plan every report on Report Schedule, write the wins, problems and recommendations on Report Notes, and prepare each quarterly meeting on Quarterly Reviews.
Write attribution notes for leads and sales you can trace to a code, link, creator or message, and judge hashtags on Hashtag Performance.

Use the 14 calculators for engagement rate, growth, reach rate, cost per follower, share of voice, goal pacing, best format, benchmark gap, test winner, the report pack, return from social, the quarter forecast, post rank and month change.
Print 10 sheets and 10 letters, follow 10 step-by-step checklists and tap a message link to open WhatsApp with the text ready.
Read Analytics Dashboard and Charts every week: reach, engagement rate, goals, overdue reports, leads and revenue.

listing.title: Social Media Analytics and Reporting Excel Template: Engagement, Growth, Benchmarks, Goals, Leads, Client Reports
listing.headline: Results and reports for every brand you manage in one file
listing.description:
Report on the social media of every brand you manage in one Excel workbook. Monthly Results holds followers, reach, impressions, engagement, clicks, video views, saves and shares for each client, platform and month, with the engagement rate, reach rate and growth worked out and compared with the benchmark of the industry.

Post Performance gives each post an engagement rate and a level, and Top And Bottom Posts records the lesson and the next action. Goals Vs Actual marks each month as met, close or missed, Follower Growth shows where new followers come from, and Audience Demographics, Website Traffic and Conversions And Leads connect social media to visits, leads, sales and cost per lead.

Competitor Tracking shows your share of the audience, Format Performance and Time Of Day show what works and when, Hashtag Performance gives a keep, test or drop call, and Experiments names the winner of every A/B test. Report Schedule warns when a report is late, Report Notes keeps the recommendations and Quarterly Reviews fills each meeting from the data.

14 calculators cover engagement rate, growth, reach rate, cost per follower, share of voice, goal pacing, best format, benchmark gap, test winner, report pack, return from social, forecast, post rank and month change. Print 10 sheets and 10 letters, follow 10 checklists and send 28 WhatsApp messages that open with the details already written in.

This is part five of the Social Media Management suite. A standard .xlsx workbook with no macros and no subscription, 15 languages in one purchase, with a demo copy full of sample data for 30 brands to explore first. It helps you measure and report your work and does not promise results.

messages.text: Hi, the results report for {brand} is ready: reach {reach} last month and an engagement rate of {er}. Shall we go through it this week?
Hi, good news: {brand} gained {gain3} followers in three months and stands at {followers}. Thank you for the great content.
Hi, the engagement rate for {brand} is {er} last month and our level is {state}. Can we talk about a new plan?
Hi {brand}, your {freq} report is ready as a {rfmt}. Please read it and send your questions.
Hi {brand}, your next report is due on {next}. Do you want us to add anything this time?
Hi {brand}, your report was due on {next} and is {left} days late. We will send it today. Sorry for the delay.
Hi {brand}, can we meet for 20 minutes to go through your {freq} report?
Hi, {brand} met the goals for {month}: {gain_act} new followers and a reach of {reach_act}. Well done!
Hi, {brand} fell short of the goals for {month}: followers reached {gain_pct} of the goal and reach {reach_pct}. Here is our plan to fix it.
Hi, {brand} came close in {month} with {gain_pct} of the follower goal. A small push next month will do it.
Hi, we want to set the goals for the next month for {brand}. Last month: engagement rate {er_act}. Do you agree to aim for {er_goal}?
Hi, our quarterly review for {brand} is on {meeting}. Your accounts gained {gain} followers this quarter. Does the date suit you?
Hi, thank you for the review meeting. For {brand} we agreed: {decision}. We will send the plan this week.
Hi, how happy are you with the results of {brand} this quarter, from 1 to 5? Your answer helps us plan the next quarter.
Hi, our test for {brand} on {platform} is done: {test}. Result: {state}, a lift of {lift}. We will use it in your plan.
Hi, may we run a test for {brand} on {platform}: {test}? It runs for {days} days and costs you nothing extra.
Hi, the test "{test}" for {brand} showed no clear difference ({lift}). We will try a bigger change next.
Hi, {competitor} is ahead of {brand} on {platform} with {followers} followers. Our share of the audience is {share}. Can we plan a catch-up push?
Hi, {brand} leads {competitor} on {platform}: share of audience {share} and a rate gap of {gap}. We will keep the pace.
Hi, {competitor} does this on {platform}: {note}. Shall we try a version for {brand}?
Hi, our recommendation for {brand}: {action}. Reason: {topic}. Do you approve?
Hi, the action "{action}" for {brand} was due on {due} and is still {state}. Can we finish it this week?
Hi, we finished the action "{action}" for {brand}. We will measure the effect and report back.
Hi, {brand} received {leads} leads and {sales} sales from {platform} in {month}, with revenue of {revenue}. Result: {state}.
Hi, a lead for {brand} on {platform} cost {cpl} in {month}. The return on spend was {roas}.
Hi, on {platform} {brand} had an engagement rate of {eng_rate} against a benchmark of {bench}. We plan a content change.
Hi, {brand} gained {gain} followers on {platform} and reached {reach} people. Growth: {growth}.
Hi, posts of {brand} on {platform} brought {clicks} link clicks (click rate {ctr}). Is your landing page ready?

Last month your accounts reached {col:clients.reach} people with an engagement rate of {col:clients.er}. Your followers now stand at {col:clients.followers}.
Over the last three months your accounts gained {col:clients.gain3} followers, and you met your monthly goals in {col:clients.met} months. Result level: {col:clients.state}.
The full numbers for each platform are attached. Please tell us if you want to change the goals for next month.

documents.title: Quarterly review letter

The quarter runs from {col:qtr.start} to {col:qtr.end}. In that time your accounts gained {col:qtr.gain} followers and reached {col:qtr.reach} people at an engagement rate of {col:qtr.er}.
Result level: {col:qtr.state}. You gave us a satisfaction score of {col:qtr.score} out of 5 and we agreed the decision: {col:qtr.decision}.
Our meeting is on {col:qtr.meeting}. Please bring your questions about the next quarter.

documents.title: Goal review letter
paragraphs: Goal review for {col:goals.brand}, month of {col:goals.month}, prepared by {set:firm} on {today}.

The goal was {col:goals.gain_goal} new followers and we gained {col:goals.gain_act}, which is {col:goals.gain_pct} of the goal. Reach was {col:goals.reach_act} against {col:goals.reach_goal}, or {col:goals.reach_pct}.
The engagement rate was {col:goals.er_act} against a goal of {col:goals.er_goal}, which is {col:goals.er_pct}. Status: {col:goals.state}.
The owner of this goal is {col:goals.owner}. We will propose the goals for next month in our next report.

documents.title: Experiment summary
paragraphs: Experiment summary for {col:exp.brand}, prepared by {set:firm} on {today}.
We tested: {col:exp.test} on {col:exp.platform}, from {col:exp.start} to {col:exp.end}.

Version A reached {col:exp.a_reach} people with {col:exp.a_eng} engagements ({col:exp.a_rate}). Version B reached {col:exp.b_reach} people with {col:exp.b_eng} engagements ({col:exp.b_rate}). The lift of B is {col:exp.lift}.
Result: {col:exp.state}. We will use this in the next content plan.

{col:comp.competitor} has {col:comp.followers} followers on {col:comp.platform}, posts {col:comp.posts_month} times a month and has an engagement rate of {col:comp.er}.
